corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez text clearly reads 'ወበምልአ ነቀወ ዶርሆ ሶቤሃ ።' (and immediately the cock crowed), which Stage 1 hallucinated as 'ወበጊዜሃ'.
Stage 1 leaked non-Ethiopic (Arabic) characters into the Ge'ez patristic citation 'አንተ ትኴንኖ ለእኁከ እንዲል ።'. The image clearly shows the Ge'ez word 'ለእኁከ'.
